# Shirley

The Glory and the Dream P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007)</sub>; Miss Shirley (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Shirley is a red-headed woman who wears her ruddy hair in long, smooth ripples or a braid. She has a pointed chin, wonderful eyes, and a freckled nose.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P24](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0024), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027), [v3 ch.Life P38](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0038)_

## History

Shirley was a student taught by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her first day at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. When after-school matters arose, Mrs. H. B. Donnell confronted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with pretentious demands regarding the names of her children, including Shirley. At the end of the day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discussed her experiences with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020)_

## Background by volume

**Volume 1**

- born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>

**Volume 4**

- lived at Green Gables for fourteen years  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>

## Quotes

> "In the years to come thy memory will shine like a star over my lonely life, as that last story we read together says. Diana, wilt thou give me a lock of thy jet-black tresses in parting to treasure forevermore?"
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010)

> "Fare thee well, my beloved friend. Henceforth we must be as strangers though living side by side. But my heart will ever be faithful to thee."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P12](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0012)

> "That is all there is left in life for me, now that my friend has been ruthlessly torn from me. In school I can look at her and muse over days departed."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017)

> “I think he has only been its nominal head for many years,” said Anne. “He is a very old man; his nephews are really at the head of the institution.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P35](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0035)

> “If I had been the boy you sent for,” said Anne wistfully, “I’d be able to help you so much now and spare you in a hundred ways. I could find it in my heart to wish I had been, just for that.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) started out as fierce academic rivals in school, competing for top marks and scholarships [R1, S1, S2]. Over time, their relationship softened into a close bond; though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially rejected his desire to be more than friends, they eventually shared quiet romantic moments and were married in the orchard at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) [S4, S6, S20].

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +13 more_

- Rival of — academic rivals in school  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--shirley.md)

[Allan](../character/allan.md) is a friend of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) who confided in her about her deceased baby [R2]. She is also among the guests who attend [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert's wedding celebrations [S7, S8].

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P38](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0038), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), +6 more_

- Friend of — confided in her about her deceased baby (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P38](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0038)</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--shirley.md)

Charlotta the Fourth admires [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and confides in her, often sharing her worries about Miss Lavendar's mood [R3, S10]. The two frequently collaborate at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), whether picking strawberries, waiting for guest arrivals, or helping prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding [S9, S12, S14].

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), +16 more_

- Friend of — admires her and confides in her (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v3 ch.Revelation P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--shirley.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's close childhood friend, having sworn eternal friendship even when briefly forced apart by Diana's mother [R4, S15]. They remain deeply devoted to each other through life's milestones, confiding their engagements, helping plan weddings, and mourning the end of Anne's teaching days [S17, S18, S19].

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +29 more_

- Friend of — close childhood friends who swore eternal friendship (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) are close friends who frequently visit one another at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) [R5, S21]. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) provides comfort during Miss Lavendar's despondent moments, helps prepare for her reunion and wedding with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and continues to visit her for quiet reflection [S22, S23, S25, S26].

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), +19 more_

- Friend of — close friends who visit each other (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P34](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0034)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) served as Paul's teacher, mentoring his artistic talents and admiring his imaginative writing [R6, R7, S28]. [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) holds great affection for her, cheering her up with wild orchids and visiting her during her stays at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) [S27, S30, S32].

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), +32 more_

### [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/shirley--stella-maynard.md)

[Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) is a friend of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) who corresponds with her through letters [R8]. In her correspondence, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares humorous anecdotes from her teaching job and composition pieces written by her students [S33].

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), +2 more_

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phil-gordon--shirley.md)

Philippa is a close friend who lives with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and later travels to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to celebrate Anne's wedding [R9, S36]. She teases [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about romantic prospects and presents her with Miss Patty's china dogs as a wedding gift [S35, S36].

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), [v3 ch.Charming P29](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0029), [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), +5 more_

- Friend of — close friends reunited at Green Gables (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043)</sub>
